parameters.query:
select
	DISTINCT(mvuru.user_id),
	mvuru.user_name ,
	mvuru.user_email,
	mbp.dispatch_role,
	mbp.branch_code ,
	mbp.is_active,
	mvuru.user_phone_number,
    mvuru.user_npk,
	mvuru.user_windows_uid
    
from
	master_branch_pic mbp
left join materialized_view_user_role_unit mvuru on
	mbp.user_id = mvuru.user_id
where
	mbp.is_active = true
and mvuru.application_code = 'aura'
and mbp.branch_code = '{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.branchCode }}'
and mbp.dispatch_role = '{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.target }}'

  const d = new Date(date);
  const offset = 7*60; //dalam menit
  const localDate = new Date(d.getTime() + offset*60*1000);
  const day = String(localDate.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const month = String(localDate.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const year = localDate.getUTCFullYear();
  const hours = String(localDate.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const minutes = String(localDate.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

};
